examples.en: She actually wanted to reconstruct the state and transform society.
examples.zh: 她其实想改造这个国家并完全改变社会。

examples.en: Investigators are trying to reconstruct the circumstances of the crash.
examples.zh: 调查人员正试图重现撞车时的情形。

examples.en: He began to reconstruct the events of December 21, 1988, when flight 103 disappeared.
examples.zh: 他开始重现1988年12月21日103航班失踪时所发生的事情。
